summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial is testing a study drug called pioglitazone compared to a placebo in people with type 2 diabetes and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. The trial aims to measure liver energy processes, known as hepatic mitochondrial fluxes, before and after 16 weeks of treatment. The study is sponsored by The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio and plans to enroll 60 participants.
